fields.label: Patient ID
fields.description: Shukhee-side patient id (resolved/created server-side from contact_number).

fields.label: Encounter ID
fields.description: Optional identifier supplied by the app; no FK, carried through for later correlation to the visit.

fields.label: Call URL
fields.description: Includes a live Shukhee access token in the query string -- can exceed Data's 140-char limit.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
pending
confirmed
accepted
completed
rejected
cancelled
on-hold

fields.label: Prescription Link
fields.description: Our own permanent File URL (downloaded from Shukhee's short-lived presigned link once completed).

fields.label: Invoice Link
fields.description: Our own permanent File URL (downloaded from Shukhee's short-lived presigned link once completed).

fields.label: Doctor Name
fields.description: From Shukhee's emergency-request `doctor.name` -- populated once Shukhee assigns a doctor, may be blank before then.

fields.label: Doctor Facility
fields.description: From Shukhee's `doctor.working_at` -- a raw facility code (e.g. "DMC"), not a formatted name.
